messages:
anna: heads up — found a weird mismatch between embeddings + rerank responses when using the new python client batching helper. reproducible with multi-inputs.

anna: example: i send 3 queries via embeddings.embed_batch(...) then call rerank.rerank_batch(...) expecting a list-of-lists of scores, but sometimes the rerank call returns a flat list of dicts for single-item batches and nested lists for multi-item batches. breaks our sampleapp eval harness.

michael: can you paste minimal repro?

anna: yep — pasted below. note the shape expectation in our app: List[List[float]] for scores per query. we get both that and List[Dict] depending on request path.

```
# repro snippet
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient, RerankClient
emb = EmbeddingsClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
rr = RerankClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
queries = ["q1","q2","q3"]
docs = ["d1","d2","d3"]
vecs = emb.embed_batch(queries)
# Expect vecs -> [[...],[...],[...]]
res = rr.rerank_batch(queries, docs, include_metadata=True)
# res sometimes -> [[0.9,0.3,0.1],[...],...] AND sometimes -> [{"id":"d1","score":0.9}, ...]
```

jamie: ugh. looks like we have two codepaths: the legacy rerank endpoint vs the new combined embeddings+ranks helper. one returns canonical scores-only shape, the other returns enriched objects. should be consistent or at least documented.

sashi: +1 on docs, but i think the bigger issue is python typing — our client types declare return as List[List[float]] but runtime can be mixed. mypy users will explode.

michael: i dug in. the server will return object form when include_metadata=True. client currently does a naive passthrough for that flag but our batching helper flattens and normalizes elsewhere, causing shape flip. we should: 1) normalize on client boundary, 2) keep raw option if someone sets raw=True.

anna: also noticed an async parity problem: EmbeddingsClient.async_embed_batch yields an AsyncIterator of vectors, but RerankClient.async_rerank_batch returns a single list. combining them in async code is awkward. e.g. `async for v in emb.async_embed_batch(qs):` vs `scores = await rr.async_rerank_batch(...)` — consistency would be nicer (either both yield or both return).

jamie: good catch. recommend both be coroutine-returning lists (awaitable) for parity, or both be stream/iterator based. lean toward awaitable lists for easier interop with existing code.

sashi: typing proposal: in client stubs use Union[List[List[float]], List[Dict[str,Any]]] currently but that's terrible UX. better: TypedResponse = TypedList[List[float]] and RawResponse = List[Dict[str, Any]]; methods: rerank(..., raw: bool = False) -> Union[TypedResponse, RawResponse] with mypy overloads so callers get narrow types.

michael: implementation-wise i can add a small normalizer in python client: if raw flag false, coerce object-form into scores-only shape, preserve ordering. also update docs + sampleapp. will PR.

anna: one more annoying bit — auth/retry interplay. when token refresh happens during async batch requests we saw a handful of 401s surface instead of retrying. logs: `aiohttp.client_exceptions.ClientResponseError: 401, message='Unauthorized'` from rr.async_rerank_batch at 10:34:12. seems our async retry middleware isn't wired into rerank async path.

michael: yep that's a separate bug. i'll patch the async transport to reuse the same retry wrapper used by sync clients. quick fix plus unit test.

jamie: can someone add a small batching helper in examples dir for sampleapp? something like `normalize_rerank_response(rsp, raw=False)` and `batch_pairwise(queries, docs, batch_size=16)` — that will reduce copy-paste in customer demos.

anna: assigning: michael for client normalizer + async retry, sashi for typing overloads, jamie for sampleapp helper + docs. i'll open a tracking issue and link PRs.

michael: created draft PR #2456 — adds normalizer + optional raw param. still needs tests. cc @sashi @jamie

ci-bot: PR 2456 draft created by michael — pipeline pending (:git_pull_request:).

sashi: i'll draft typing PR after michael's changes land, will include mypy tests.

jamie: i'll add example snippet to /examples/embeddings-rerank/ and a small note in the SDK migration guide.

anna: thanks all. can we try to get this into this week's patch? it's blocking a partner demo. :pray:

michael: pushing for end-of-day patch, will keep updates in the PR thread.

anna: if anyone hits the same issue and needs a hotfix patch locally, quick workaround: call rr.rerank_batch(..., raw=True) and then convert via this helper (py):

```
def normalize_rerank_response(resp):
    # resp can be list of dicts or list of lists
    if not resp:
        return []
    if isinstance(resp[0], dict):
        # convert to scores-only assuming 'score' key and ordering preserved
        return [[d['score'] for d in resp]]
    return resp
```

anna: ok i'm off to the partner call; will update after PRs land. :wave:
